activity_contract.growth_rule: verified elapsed training only; current role, assignment, useful deficits, instructors and lawful opportunity determine development; future canon skill is never pre-granted

autonomous_activity_state.verification_rule: structured causal cycles derive verified hours from the registered exact/institution/career/role/billet standard; allegiance never caps or multiplies training; planned opportunity prose never creates hours

behavior.ambition_or_orientation: rise through merit while keeping people alive with flexible command
behavior.decision_style: likes having one practical fallback ready before taking a risk
behavior.failure_response: reviews the mistake and changes procedure
behavior.stress_response: uses speed of thought and maneuver rather than forcing bad frontal contests
behavior.temperament: young_commander; stable behavior follows saved history and incentives
behavior.trust_style: status-aware but willing to revise judgments
values: earn command credibility through study, service, and performance rather than family name

appointments.rule: current assignment only; creates no guaranteed future promotion or canon outcome

career_state.rank_billet_span_rule: Durable rank, current billet, and current command span are separate saved facts; only explicit promotion/demotion changes rank.

command_assignment.rule: Current command span follows exact surviving formation strength and may change without changing durable rank.

canon_capability_calibration.rule: floor-only current capability calibration; no future history or outcome is pre-granted

training_regimen_migration_history.access_basis: saved equipment/loadout only; historical facility and instructor are not reconstructed

canon_capability_calibration_history.rule: floor-only current capability calibration; no future history or outcome is pre-granted

current_goals: earn command credibility through study, service, and performance rather than family name
institutional_duties: act within current Qin political and military obligations
long_term_goals: earn command credibility through study, service, and performance rather than family name
personal_desires: rise through merit while keeping people alive with flexible command

military_rank.rule: Only explicit career promotion/demotion changes grade; billet and current troop span changes do not.
